Here we see the friend in her natural habitat

Here we see the friend in her natural habitat. She has not replied since August. She posted nine stories today.

alt: A short film with no voice, shot like a nature documentary. A dim bedroom. A small amber block figure with white eyes sits on a bed staring at a phone, trembling slightly as if scrolling. A label in the corner reads WILD FRIENDS. The narration appears as subtitles: here we see the friend in her natural habitat. She has not replied since August. But she posted nine stories today. Call her. The figure looks up at the camera, caught, with a smile.
